_meta.description: Validation rules for AICTE New Engineering Institution Approval
_meta.source: Based on AICTE Approval Process Handbook (representative rules for SIH26261 demo)

rules.description: Minimum land area must be at least 2.5 acres for engineering institutions
rules.error_message: Land area ({value} acres) is below the minimum requirement of 2.5 acres.
rules.suggestion: Acquire additional land to meet the 2.5-acre minimum or provide documentation for approved exemptions (e.g., multi-storey building approval in metro cities).

rules.description: Trust or Society must be registered and found in the official registry
rules.error_message: Trust/Society registration number '{value}' was not found in the official registry.
rules.suggestion: Verify the registration number is correct. Ensure the trust is registered under the Indian Trusts Act, 1882 or Societies Registration Act, 1860.

rules.description: Faculty-to-student ratio must be at least 1:20 (ratio >= 0.05)
rules.error_message: Faculty-student ratio ({value}) is below the minimum required ratio of 1:20 (0.05).
rules.suggestion: Recruit additional qualified faculty members to achieve the required 1:20 faculty-student ratio before resubmitting.

rules.description: All faculty members must hold minimum qualification (M.Tech/M.E. or PhD for engineering programs)
rules.error_message: Faculty member '{name}' holds '{qualification}' which does not meet the minimum qualification requirement.
rules.suggestion: Ensure all faculty members hold at least M.Tech/M.E. or equivalent postgraduate degree. Faculty with only B.Tech/B.E. are not eligible for engineering program teaching positions.

rules.description: Document integrity check - tamper detection score must be below 0.4
rules.error_message: Document '{document_name}' has a tamper score of {value} (threshold: 0.4). Possible tampering detected.
rules.suggestion: Re-upload original, unmodified documents. Scanned copies should be certified by a gazetted officer. Digital documents must retain original metadata.

rules.description: NOC (No Objection Certificate) must not be expired and must be issued by a recognized authority
rules.error_message: NOC is either expired (expiry: {expiry_date}) or issued by an unrecognized authority ('{issuer}').
rules.suggestion: Obtain a valid NOC from the State Government or affiliating university. Ensure the NOC is current and issued within the approval cycle year.

rules.description: Trust/Society registration must be at least 1 year before the application submission date
rules.error_message: Trust registration date ({value}) is less than 1 year before the application date ({reference_date}).
rules.suggestion: The trust must have been registered at least 1 year prior to the application date. If recently registered, wait until the eligibility period is met.

rules.description: Minimum built-up carpet area must be at least 5000 sq ft per 60-student intake
rules.error_message: Built-up carpet area ({value} sq ft) is below the minimum requirement of 5000 sq ft per 60-student intake.
rules.suggestion: Expand the built-up area to meet the 5000 sq ft minimum per 60-student intake. Provide updated building completion certificate from a registered architect.

rules.description: Application submission date must not be in the future
rules.error_message: Application submission date ({value}) is in the future.
rules.suggestion: Correct the application submission date. The date must reflect the actual date of submission and cannot be a future date.

rules.description: All mandatory documents must be submitted with the application
rules.suggestion: Upload all mandatory documents before submission. Incomplete applications are automatically rejected without further review.
